C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 229
Date 6/4/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

April 5th 1916

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,

It is reported that several ex-soldiers who have been enrolled as rebels, are now in Shanghai staying in different lodging houses in Frenchtown. They receive money for their sustenance from no.3? Amiral Bayle.
There are rumours in the City that an attack will soon be made on the Arsenal and residents are removing to the Settlement.
It is reported that a rebel leader named Mau Chih Ying has left here for Hangchow with $25,000 in order to buy over the police of that City.
It is said that the Arsenal Authorities suspect that the gunners have been bought over by the rebels. Commencing from yesterday nobody is allowed south of St.Catherine's Bridge after 6 p.m.
Despite the amount of money that the rebels here are alleged to be receiving they still complain that they are short of funds.
Four women are now employed searching female passengers on the Shanghai Nanking Railway.
General Yang has ordered the 13th and 14th regiments consisting of some three thousand men to be in readiness to start for Canton. The men comprising these regiments are at present quartered in the vicinity of the Arsenal. Two thousand men are expected to arrive here soon from Shantung and Chili to take the place of the troops who are sent away.

Your Obedient Servant,

（签名）

Chief Detective Inspector.

（批：A. Ssu.）

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（批：Entered on M.S. Apl. 5）

刑事侦缉处
情报官登记
第 229 号
日期 16/4/6

上海工部局。

1916年4月5日

（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探股）

先生：

据报，几名被征募为叛军的退伍士兵现居于上海法租界内的不同客栈。他们从贝勒海军上将路3号？领取生活费用。
市内谣传兵工厂即将遭到袭击，居民正迁往租界。
据报，一名名为茅志英（Mau Chih Ying，音译）的叛军首领已携带25,000美元离开此地前往杭州，意图收买该城市的警察。
据悉，兵工厂当局怀疑炮手已被叛军收买。自昨日起，下午6点后任何人不得进入圣凯瑟琳桥以南地区。
尽管据称此地的叛军获得了大量资金，但他们仍抱怨资金短缺。
目前有四名妇女受雇在沪宁铁路上搜查女性乘客。
杨将军已命令由约三千人组成的第13和第14团做好出发前往广州的准备。组成这些团的士兵目前驻扎在兵工厂附近。预计不久将有二千名士兵从山东和直隶抵达此地，以接替被调走的部队。

您顺从的仆人，

（签名）

总探长。

（批：A. Ssu.）

警务处总监。

（批：已于4月5日录入MS）
